gloss: to do ~ over again; to redo ~

definitions.gloss: to do ~ over again; to redo ~
definitions.explanation: Attaches to the masu-stem of a verb to indicate repeating an action from the beginning, usually to correct or improve the result. The resulting compound conjugates as a godan verb.

examples.japanese: もう{一度|いちど}やり{直|なお}そう。
{間違|まちが}いがあったので、{書|か}き{直|なお}してください。
examples.english: There was a mistake, so please rewrite it.

examples.japanese: {計画|けいかく}がうまくいかなかったから、ゼロから{考|かんが}え{直|なお}す{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: The plan didn't work out, so we need to rethink it from scratch.

notes:
FORMATION:
Attaches to the masu-stem ({連用形|れんようけい}) of verbs:
- やる → やり + {直|なお}す → やり{直|なお}す
- {書|か}く → {書|か}き + {直|なお}す → {書|か}き{直|なお}す
- {見|み}る → {見|み} + {直|なお}す → {見|み}{直|なお}す

The compound conjugates as a godan verb ({直|なお}す).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- やり{直|なお}す (to redo)
- {書|か}き{直|なお}す (to rewrite)
- {見|み}{直|なお}す (to review; to reconsider)
- {作|つく}り{直|なお}す (to remake)
- {出|で}{直|なお}す (to start over from the beginning)
- {考|かんが}え{直|なお}す (to reconsider)

USAGE:
Implies that the first attempt was unsatisfactory or needs improvement. Unlike simply repeating an action (もう{一度|いちど}する), ～{直|なお}す carries the nuance of correcting or doing better the second time around.
